name: EPACK Durable Limited
summary: EPACK Durable Limited makes original-design room air conditioners in India, including window units, inverter models, and indoor and outdoor units. It also produces small appliances such as induction cooktops, air fryers and mixer-grinders, larger appliances like washing machines and air coolers, and components including heat exchangers and PCBAs. Incorporated in 2003, it is based in Noida and exports its products.
